# vngcloud_vdb_kafka_cluster (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vngcloud_vdb_kafka_cluster" "kafka" {
  name                    = "tf-kafka-cluster"
  kafka_version           = "3.7.0"
  server_flavor_id        = data.vngcloud_vdb_kafka_package.kafka_s_general_2x4.id
  kafka_broker_count      = 3
  kafka_storage_type      = data.vngcloud_vdb_kafka_volume_type.Gen2_NVMe2_IOPS3000.id
  kafka_storage_size      = 20
  vserver_project_id      = "pro-e28d4501-59d8-4f47-9eb0-948c54f80592"
  network_id              = "net-55fb222e-2807-4747-8748-8c84747cc2b1"
  subnet_id               = "sub-693bae5c-c40e-484a-91dd-447ff8a94293"
  mtls_authen             = true
  sasl_authen             = false
  public_access           = true
  encryption_volume       = false
  config_group_version_id = vngcloud_vdb_kafka_config_group.kafka_config.current_version_id
  auto_rebalance_topics   = true

  security_group_rules {
    remote_ip = "0.0.0.0/0"
    port      = 9094
  }
  security_group_rules {
    remote_ip = "0.0.0.0/0"
    port      = 9196
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- **name** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The name of the kafka cluster. This field is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **kafka_version** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The Kafka version (e.g. `3.7.0`). This field is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **server_flavor_id** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The flavor ID for the broker nodes. Use the `vngcloud_vdb_kafka_package` data source to look up. This field is required and cannot be changed after creation.

- **kafka_broker_count** (Int, Required):
    - The number of broker nodes (3 - 10). Increasing or decreasing this value triggers a scale out / scale in operation.

- **kafka_storage_type** (String, Required):
    - The volume type ID for broker storage. Use the `vngcloud_vdb_kafka_volume_type` data source to look up. Changing this value triggers a Resize Broker IOPS operation (storage type swap).

- **kafka_storage_size** (Int, Required):
    - The broker volume size (GB). Changing this value triggers a Resize Broker Storage size operation.

- **vserver_project_id** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The vServer project ID where the cluster is provisioned.

- **network_id** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The network ID where the cluster is attached.

- **subnet_id** (String, Required, ForceNew):
    - The subnet ID where broker nodes are launched.

- **mtls_authen** (Bool, Optional):
    - Enable mTLS authentication. Defaults to `false`. Changing this value triggers an Edit Access control methods operation.

- **sasl_authen** (Bool, Optional):
    - Enable SASL authentication. Defaults to `false`. Changing this value triggers an Edit Access control methods operation.

- **public_access** (Bool, Optional):
    - Enable public accessibility (assign floating IPs to brokers). Defaults to `false`. Changing this value triggers an Edit Public accessibility operation.

- **config_group_version_id** (String, Optional):
    - The configuration group version ID applied to the cluster. Changing this value triggers a Change Configuration group version operation.

- **encryption_volume** (Bool, Optional, ForceNew):
    - Enable volume encryption at rest. Defaults to `false`. Cannot be changed after creation.

- **auto_rebalance_topics** (Bool, Optional):
    - Whether to automatically rebalance topics across brokers when scaling out (`kafka_broker_count` increased). Ignored when scaling in. Defaults to `false`.

- **security_group_rules** (Set of object, Optional, Computed):
    - The security group rules controlling network access to the cluster. Each rule contains:
        - **remote_ip** (String, Required): The remote IP CIDR allowed to access the cluster.
        - **port** (Int, Required): The Kafka listener port. Allowed values: `9092`, `9094`, `9096`, `9194`, `9196`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to all arguments above, the following attributes are exported:

- **id** (String) The ID of the kafka cluster.

- **status** (String, Computed):
    - The current status of the cluster (e.g. `ACTIVE`, `UPDATING`, ...).

- **error_message** (String, Computed):
    - The latest error message reported by the cluster, if any.

- **portal_user_id** (Int, Computed):
    - The portal user ID that owns the cluster.

- **created_at** (String, Computed):
    - The time when the cluster was created.

- **fixed_ips** (List of String, Computed):
    - The internal IP addresses of broker nodes.

- **floating_ips** (List of String, Computed):
    - The public floating IP addresses of broker nodes (only populated when `public_access = true`).

- **kafka_storage_usage** (List of Int, Computed):
    - The current storage usage (bytes) of each broker.

- **iops** (Int, Computed):
    - The IOPS of broker volumes, derived from the storage type.

- **volume_type** (String, Computed):
    - The friendly name of the broker volume type (e.g. `Gen2-NVMe2-IOPS3000`).

- **volume_type_zone_id** (String, Computed):
    - The zone ID of the broker volume type.

- **ram** (Int, Computed):
    - The amount of RAM (GB) per broker.

- **vcpus** (Int, Computed):
    - The number of vCPUs per broker.

- **instance_type** (String, Computed):
    - The instance type / package SKU of broker nodes (e.g. `db-kafka.s-general-2x4-n10`).

- **security_group_rules[].id** (String, Computed):
    - The ID of the security group rule.

- **security_group_rules[].status** (String, Computed):
    - The status of the security group rule.
